+func (s *TLSSuite) TestRemoteClusterHeartbeatAfterTunnelDeletion(c *check.C) {
+	auth := s.server.Auth()
+	clusterName := "heartbeat.example.com"
+	rc, err := services.NewRemoteCluster(clusterName)
+	c.Assert(err, check.IsNil)
+	c.Assert(auth.Presence.CreateRemoteCluster(rc), check.IsNil)
+
+	assertCluster := func(status string, heartbeat time.Time) {
+		got, err := auth.GetRemoteCluster(clusterName)
+		c.Assert(err, check.IsNil)
+		c.Assert(got.GetConnectionStatus(), check.Equals, status)
+		c.Assert(got.GetLastHeartbeat().Equal(heartbeat), check.Equals, true)
+		stored, err := auth.Presence.GetRemoteCluster(clusterName)
+		c.Assert(err, check.IsNil)
+		c.Assert(stored.GetConnectionStatus(), check.Equals, status)
+		c.Assert(stored.GetLastHeartbeat().Equal(heartbeat), check.Equals, true)
+	}
+
+	assertCluster(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOffline, time.Time{})
+	firstHeartbeat := time.Now().Add(-time.Second).UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
+	first, err := services.NewTunnelConnection("first", services.TunnelConnectionSpecV2{
+		ClusterName: clusterName, ProxyName: "proxy", LastHeartbeat: firstHeartbeat,
+	})
+	c.Assert(err, check.IsNil)
+	c.Assert(auth.Presence.UpsertTunnelConnection(first), check.IsNil)
+	assertCluster(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline, firstHeartbeat)
+	first.SetLastHeartbeat(firstHeartbeat.Add(time.Second))
+	c.Assert(auth.Presence.UpsertTunnelConnection(first), check.IsNil)
+	assertCluster(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline, first.GetLastHeartbeat())
+
+	latestHeartbeat := firstHeartbeat.Add(2 * time.Second)
+	latest, err := services.NewTunnelConnection("latest", services.TunnelConnectionSpecV2{
+		ClusterName: clusterName, ProxyName: "proxy", LastHeartbeat: latestHeartbeat,
+	})
+	c.Assert(err, check.IsNil)
+	c.Assert(auth.Presence.UpsertTunnelConnection(latest), check.IsNil)
+	assertCluster(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline, latestHeartbeat)
+
+	c.Assert(auth.Presence.DeleteTunnelConnection(clusterName, latest.GetName()), check.IsNil)
+	assertCluster(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline, latestHeartbeat)
+	c.Assert(auth.Presence.DeleteTunnelConnection(clusterName, first.GetName()), check.IsNil)
+	assertCluster(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOffline, latestHeartbeat)
+}
+
+func (s *TLSSuite) TestUpdateRemoteCluster(c *check.C) {
+	clt, err := s.server.NewClient(TestAdmin())
+	c.Assert(err, check.IsNil)
+	rc, err := services.NewRemoteCluster("updated.example.com")
+	c.Assert(err, check.IsNil)
+	c.Assert(clt.CreateRemoteCluster(rc), check.IsNil)
+	heartbeat := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
+	rc.SetConnectionStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOffline)
+	rc.SetLastHeartbeat(heartbeat)
+	c.Assert(clt.UpdateRemoteCluster(context.Background(), rc), check.IsNil)
+	stored, err := s.server.Auth().Presence.GetRemoteCluster(rc.GetName())
+	c.Assert(err, check.IsNil)
+	c.Assert(stored.GetConnectionStatus(), check.Equals, teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOffline)
+	c.Assert(stored.GetLastHeartbeat().Equal(heartbeat), check.Equals, true)
+}
